evidence: LightningDataModule.load_from_checkpoint returned lightning.pytorch.core.datamodule.LightningDataModule instead of the concrete TestDataSaveHparams subclass. The saved checkpoint contained datamodule_hyper_parameters with _class_path, _instantiator, batch_size, and num_workers.
steps: Created a CPU-only venv and installed the local Lightning source snapshot in editable mode.
Ran LightningCLI with a subclass datamodule, trained for one epoch, and saved a checkpoint.
Loaded the checkpoint through LightningDataModule.load_from_checkpoint and observed the base class instead of the subclass.
